facts.fact: The Louvre museum closes on 1 January,1 May and 25 December. The page separately lists winter Tuileries Garden hours; museum holiday closure must not be applied automatically to the outdoor garden.
facts.excerpt: the Louvre is closed on 1 January
facts.location: Public holidays and separate Tuileries Garden blocks.
